# bench-site

Public results of the assume-eval CAS benchmark, served by GitHub Pages at
<https://bench.tilorc.com/>.

**Generated content: do not edit by hand.** Everything here except this README
and `CNAME` is written by the benchmark harness's public export
(`tools/static_export.py --out <this checkout> --public-suites ... --cname bench.tilorc.com`)
and replaced on every export. It holds the official, non-held-out cases of the
public suites only.

The pages are not meant to be indexed: every page carries
`<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">`, and `robots.txt` deliberately
allows crawling so that crawlers can see that tag.
